# `inbox-archive/v1` — _inbox_archive.json — archived inbox items

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.InboxArchiveJson` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Top-level JSON object listing opaque archive keys
(`approval:<task_path>`, `audit:<ts>|<action>|<target>`) that
the director has stashed via the Archive tab. Not part of the
audit contract — append-only doesn't apply. The ONE admitted
exception to GEP-3's format rules (GEP-25 D7).

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `keys`

**Optional:** `updated_at`


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `keys`, `updated_at`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
{
  "kind": "inbox-archive/v1",
  "keys": ["approval:projects/release/tasks/release-01.md"],
  "updated_at": "2026-04-21T10:00:00Z"
}
```
